item.title: A Quiet Bungalow in The Heart of Aviemore
item.description: Set in a quiet cul de sac in Dalnabay, Aviemore, this two bedroom bungalow offers single level living, modern interiors, and easy access to village amenities and outdoor spaces within the Cairngorms National Park.The post A Quiet Bungalow in The Heart of Aviemore appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Progress on A9 Dualling Highlighted as First Minister Visits Tomatin to Moy
item.description: The First Minister is visiting the Tomatin to Moy section of the A9 today as construction continues on the £3.9 billion dualling programme, highlighting progress, local benefits and the long term commitment to improving Scotland’s main Highland transport route.The post Progress on A9 Dualling Highlighted as First Minister Visits Tomatin to Moy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Crunch Time for Short Term Lets as Council Committee Meets
item.description: Highland Council is approaching a key decision on short term lets as councillors consider consulting on control areas for Inverness and rural communities, with growing concern about housing availability, affordability and the long term sustainability of communities across the Highlands.The post Crunch Time for Short Term Lets as Council Committee Meets appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Shetland Marks Safer Internet Day 2026 With Focus on Responsible Use of AI
item.description: Shetland is marking Safer Internet Day 2026 with a focus on the safe and responsible use of AI, encouraging families and communities to help young people build digital skills and confidence online. The post Shetland Marks Safer Internet Day 2026 With Focus on Responsible Use of AI appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Businesses Invited to Take Part in Paid Summer Placements for 2026
item.description: Highland businesses are being invited to take part in the 2026 Paid Summer Placement programme, offering paid work experience for young people aged 16 and over while helping employers support skills development and retain local talent.The post Highland Businesses Invited to Take Part in Paid Summer Placements for 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UK’s Only Male European Forest Reindeer Returns to Highland Wildlife Park
item.description: The UK’s only male European forest reindeer has returned to Highland Wildlife Park after a stay at Whipsnade Zoo, rejoining a small herd as part of efforts to support the conservation of the vulnerable species.The post UK’s Only Male European Forest Reindeer Returns to Highland Wildlife Park appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Flynn Says Starmer Must Resign as Labour Chaos Deepens
item.description: SNP Westminster leader Stephen Flynn has called on Keir Starmer to resign, saying Labour is in chaos and failing on the cost of living, while accusing Anas Sarwar of avoiding scrutiny over the Mandelson scandal.The post Flynn Says Starmer Must Resign as Labour Chaos Deepens appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ministers Open Inverness Castle Experience After £47 Million Transformation
item.description: The Inverness Castle Experience has officially opened after a £47 million transformation, creating a major new Highlands visitor attraction expected to support jobs, boost tourism and generate millions for the regional economy.The post Ministers Open Inverness Castle Experience After £47 Million Transformation appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Emergency Gas Works to Begin at Raigmore Interchange in Inverness
item.description: Emergency gas works will begin at the A96 and A9 Raigmore interchange in Inverness from 10 February, with lane closures in place for around 15 weeks to protect gas supplies to homes and businesses.The post Emergency Gas Works to Begin at Raigmore Interchange in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Characterful Stone Cottage in The Village of Alves
item.description: Set in the village of Alves near Forres and Elgin, Tucker Cottage is a traditional stone home with a characterful interior and generous garden spaces, offering village living, countryside access, and a strong sense of privacy within a well-connected Moray location.The post A Characterful Stone Cottage in The Village of Alves appeared first on The Highland Times.
